scope: Supplementary external-validity replication; original synthetic protocol and evidence unchanged.

selection_rationale.Beauty: hair texture with smooth face and dark background
selection_rationale.Jockey: horse and rider motion with panning camera
selection_rationale.HoneyBee: localized bee and flower with low-texture defocused background

selection.frames: zero-based first 60 consecutive frames, no temporal subsampling
selection.acquisition: HTTP range-seekable 7z extraction of exact raw prefix. Archive metadata and fetched compressed blocks retained. Whole-archive integrity is not claimed when partial; raw prefix length and SHA-256 recorded.
selection.availability_failure: Retries up to 3 per HTTP range; no replacement sequences. If any of the three cannot be obtained exactly, report incomplete and consult parent before any change.
selection.exclusions: No outcome-based exclusion, no re-encode after observing activity or performance. Failed cells remain failures.

derived_1080p.method: per-plane nonoverlapping 2x2 box mean, round by (sum+2)//4, 8-bit planar 4:2:0
derived_1080p.source_relation: 1080p and 4K are paired derivatives of the same scene, not independent source sequences

correctness.criterion: all 60 output frames, no status error, identical SHA-256 of all visible planar pixel bytes across variants within each cell

activity_allocation.activity: count instrumented cdef_frame events / 60 output frames, with actual max workers; an event means full CDEF stage entered, not fraction of pixels modified
activity_allocation.criterion: at least one CDEF-active frame in each encoded stream; record zero-active failure without exclusion or re-encode. Allocation verifies requested bytes against R/W formula and reports usable bytes separately.
activity_allocation.timing_from_instrumented_builds: diagnostic only; excluded from performance endpoint

timing.endpoint: sum of CLOCK_MONOTONIC wall time spent inside aom_codec_decode calls including final flush; preloading, setup, image retrieval/hashing and destruction excluded. No internal CDEF stage attribution.
timing.balance: each block/cell has exactly one AB and one BA pair; randomize which comes first. Randomize cell order independently per block, including warmup block.
timing.before_timing: wait parent GO after all competing build/encode/check activity has ceased; capture process snapshot; report host limitations, no claim exclusive machine
timing.session_failure: record and stop on nonzero exit, missing output, frame count or pixel mismatch, timeout120s. No replacement measurement or outlier deletion; all earlier rows preserved. Resume only by recording a new explicitly labeled campaign, not pooling silently.

statistics.unit: within-cell pair ratio token/type_fix; not individual frames
statistics.primary_interval: two-pair block bootstrap: sample 12 whole adjacent balanced-order blocks with replacement, compute median of 24 ratios, 50000 replicates, np.quantile linear 0.025/0.975
statistics.decision: PASS_NONINFERIOR_SCREEN if upper<=1.02; MATERIAL_SLOWDOWN if lower>1.02; INCONCLUSIVE otherwise. All cells must PASS for a nominal all-cell screening claim.
statistics.multiplicity: 95% intervals are cellwise, not simultaneous. Report all 12 cells; do not claim familywise 95% noninferiority or universal <=2%.
statistics.secondary: median decode milliseconds, RSS descriptive context, observed min/max ratios; no new post-hoc alternative may replace primary.

lineage.input_lock: After encoding, inputs.json records raw/encoded/binary/script hashes and is frozen before any decoder outcome observation; protocol settings never overwritten.
lineage.scripts: code debugging before measurements allowed with retained change log; after measurement changes require separate disclosed amendment, no silent refreeze.
